summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandfather; father of Maria Antonia DiBiasi.
bio: Tree: Giovanni P. Dibiasi (b. 1829) + Rosa Siconolfi (b. 1840); his parents Domenico Di Biase (b. 1789) + Angela Carrozzino. FS tree G4YR-BXY: Giovanni Pasquale DiBiasi (b. c.1829) and Rosa Siconolfi (b. 1839) 'born Lucera, Foggia', with zero sources. Their children Domenico Antonio (1856) and Maria Antonia (1870) were born in Guardia. The same FS profiles list children born in 1891 and 1894, when Rosa would have been 52-55 - mis-attachments. Round 1 concluded the Lucera thumbnail (on Domenico Di Biase in the Ancestry tree) is probably someone else's record: Guardia's records are at AS Avellino, while Lucera holds a branch archive for Foggia-province records and Di Biase is a common Capitanata surname. Round 2: remove Lucera. Round 3: still speculative/unsourced.
openQuestions: Marriage to Rosa Siconolfi (Guardia 1850-54 marriage indexes downloaded but unread)
